mapper.select: SELECT workspace_id FROM deal_duplicate_review_proof WHERE expires_at <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) GROUP BY workspace_id ORDER BY MIN(expires_at), workspace_id LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO deal_duplicate_review_proof (token_hash, workspace_id, actor_id, workflow_hash, result_hash, expires_at) VALUES (#{tokenHash}, #{workspaceId}, #{actorId}, #{workflowHash}, #{resultHash}, TIMESTAMPADD(SECOND, #{ttlSeconds}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6)))
